inner_cv: Three stratified folds within outer training subjects
outer_cv: Same five repeated five-fold participant splits as duration_locked_v1
secondary_comparison: Train block five / test block five minus train block one / test block five
source_block: One of five nonoverlapping 60-second intervals from each training participant
target_block: One of five intervals from each held-out participant
uncertainty: Stratified participant bootstrap of held-out predictions keeping all repeated observations together
